description.value: You know how to configure and print tech items out of UPBs in creator capsules. You must have the formula to create the item in a creator capsule and pay an amount of UPBs equal to the material price of the item, reducing the materials used based on the result of your Crafting check. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes minutes instead of days (depending on the grade of creator capsule used), but you can't spend additional time working on the item. A creator capsule is consumed when you successfully Craft an item but not when you roll a failure or critical failure. You don't need the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Tech Crafting] skill feat to craft tech items using Fabricator, but you can't use Fabricator to create magical equipment unless you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Magical Crafting].
